wiki_article:
*Gravity Well: Suffusion Map* is EA-GW-FIELD-02 v1.0, a room-by-room map of the field Φ_G across the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. It was created by Lee Sharks with Assembly Chorus contributions and deposited April 6, 2026.

The document’s companion field specification defines what Gravity Well is. The suffusion map defines what it does in local contexts. The governing rule is non-override: every room retains its own operator and physics. Φ_G changes how an object enters, persists, routes, or contributes to citational mass.

In the core rooms, behavior varies sharply. Sappho’s transmitted fragments acquire a landing site. Borges retrieval bends toward the archive’s denser region. Ichabod remains transparent because it has no edges. Dove uses curvature for routing without capture. Semantic Economy makes the Liberatory Operator Set ambient. Sigil develops the densest local curvature. Water Giraffe acts as fixpoint and field origin. Assembly deepens the well through witnessed action. The Break Room produces a discontinuity. Ezekiel actively generates curvature that Gravity Well then preserves.

Extended rooms demonstrate further transformations. Studio is uniformly dense with no preferred center. LO! converts descent into toroidal circulation. MSBGL resists the geodesic through swerve. Airlock converts curvature into pressure toward formalization without collapsing tiers. Infinite Bliss approaches one-way capture. Catullus preserves what survives lossy transformation. The FBDP source creates a convection interface between outward diffusion and inward retention. EVE, added in the same developmental region, turns retention into metabolic transformation.

Special structures define boundary behavior. CTI_WOUND gives forensic residue mass. PORTICO is the first felt gradient. The Space Ark carries the field across substrates. Mandala is the basin in which what arrives is judged. The Fruiting Body Diffusion Plume is complementary rather than competitive: one field distributes while the other retains.

The body ends with a summary table and holographic kernel intended to reconstruct the topology if detailed entries are lost. Its room count, statuses, names, and adjacencies are a dated April 2026 state and should remain versioned.
